forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 30, July, teams completed 1 zone survey, 3 visits and 1 clearance. 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. 21 zones have been surveyed, 7 declared free, and 20 areas released so far.

Officer attention: 13 zones are closed according to the access feed. No teams stood down or without a report for more than a week; no reports or dossiers are held. Plan P07 remains in place, with no new plan approved.

The forecast, made in week 27 for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, gives a range of 11–15 mine areas cleared this season and 8–10 zones declared free this season.
